claims.value: 632 RAW files (all deposited .raw; excluding 6 MaxQuant .txt tables)
claims.evidence: PRIDE files/all lists 638 files: 632 .raw + Horse/Human/Mouse/Pig/Rat/ZF.txt MaxQuant tables. Filenames encode Species_Heart_{id}_{Chamber}_Fraction_{n}.

claims.value: Homo sapiens, Equus caballus, Sus scrofa domesticus, Mus musculus, Rattus norvegicus, Danio rerio
claims.evidence: PRIDE organisms and PLoS Biol Methods (human + horse + pig + rat + mouse + zebrafish). Pig annotated as Sus scrofa domesticus (NCBITaxon:9825) per PRIDE sampleAttributes.

claims.value: Chamber-resolved UBERON atrium/ventricle terms from filename tokens
claims.evidence: Methods: LA/RA/LV/RV for mammals; atrium and ventricle for zebrafish. Human RV not sampled (mitral valve surgery via RA). Filename chambers Left/Right_Atria|Atrium|Ventricle mapped to UBERON:0002079/0002078/0002084/0002080; zebrafish Atria/Ventricle to UBERON:0002081/0002082.
Mixed Homo sapiens + non-human vertebrates; human and vertebrates organism templates are mutually exclusive. Same mixed-species precedent as PXD028979.
Human biopsies from 3 males undergoing mitral valve replacement/plasty. Animal donors had no cardiac illness (horses euthanized for lameness; lab animals healthy).

claims.value: Species-level metadata from S1 Text; unavailable fields marked not available
claims.evidence: Mouse: male C57BL/6BomTac, age 9W (8W purchase + 1W acclimatization). Rat: male Wistar 150g (age not stated). Pig: female Danish Landrace 11W. Horse: female mares (ages 8Y and 16-18Y not mappable to Heart_1/2/3). Zebrafish: adult AB, sex not stated, 10 fish pooled per chamber sample. Human: male, ages 52-64Y not mapped to patient IDs 130/142/146.

claims.value: 3 biological replicates per species (mapped from individual IDs)
claims.evidence: Paper: 3 biological replicates per species. Filename IDs Human 130/142/146; Mouse 4/5/6; others 1/2/3 remapped to bio-rep 1-3 within species.

claims.value: Q Exactive (generic); DDA Top12 HCD; MS1 375-1500 m/z
claims.evidence: PRIDE instruments field is Q Exactive. Sample protocol/main paper say Q-Exactive HF; S1 Text says Q-Exactive Plus; filenames use QE3/QE5/QE7. Annotated as generic Q Exactive because the three sources conflict and per-file HF vs Plus cannot be resolved.

claims.value: Lys-C+Trypsin; Carbamidomethyl fixed; Oxidation/Acetyl/Gln->pyro-Glu/Deamidated(NQ) variable; precursor 4.5 ppm
claims.evidence: PRIDE sample protocol + S1 Text: Lys-C then trypsin; CAA alkylation. Search mods from S1 Text: Carbamidomethyl fixed; Oxidation(M), Acetyl protein N-term, deamidation(NQ), Gln->pyro-Glu variable. PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol omits deamidation — S1 peer-reviewed Methods take precedence for deposited-study description. Precursor mass tolerance = MaxQuant main-search 4.5 ppm.

claims.value: hpHRP concatenated fractions; identifiers from filenames (mostly 1-10; some 1-12)
claims.evidence: S1 Text/paper: high-pH RP, 10 concatenated fractions. PRIDE sample protocol describes 12 concatenated fractions. Horse_3 atria filenames have fractions 1-12; Zebrafish_1 missing fraction 7 (atria) or 6 (ventricle).

claims.location: factor value[organism] and factor value[organism part]
claims.value: Both species and chamber are experimental factors
claims.evidence: Study design compares protein abundance across species and across cardiac chambers.

claims.value: adult (EFO:0001272) for human/horse/mouse/rat/zebrafish; juvenile (PATO:0001190) for pig
claims.evidence: S1 Text: pigs are 11 weeks old (25-35 kg Danish Landrace sows) — pre-pubertal grower age, annotated juvenile. Human patients 52-64Y; horses 8–18Y mares; mice ~9W after acclimatization; zebrafish adult AB; rats 150g males (age not stated; annotated adult as cohort-level approximation).

limitations: Instrument annotated as generic Q Exactive (MS:1001911) because PRIDE sample protocol/main paper (HF), S1 Text (Plus), and filename QE3/QE5/QE7 codes conflict and cannot be reconciled per file.
Per-individual human ages/BMI and horse ages/breeds are not recoverable from filenames; cohort-level details recorded only in evidence.
Rat age not stated (only 150g body weight).
Collision energy / NCE not reported in protocols (column omitted).
Rat developmental stage annotated adult despite age-not-stated (150g only); borderline juvenile/adult.
PRIDE dataProcessingProtocol omits deamidation(NQ) while S1 Text includes it; SDRF follows S1 Text peer-reviewed Methods.
